decisions.reason: The Zebra palette change does not necessarily alter the basket-weave requirement. The same message separately selects the 7.5 cm weave scale, which is already represented, while possible lightening is tentative and the existing mustard border remains unchanged.
Lightening the Zebra palette does not change production readiness, CMYK output, or seamless-repeat file requirements.
The requested Zebra colour adjustment does not change the independently specified mustard block-colour pareo.
The requested Zebra colour adjustment does not change the independently specified terracotta or burgundy block-colour pareo.
The Zebra palette direction changes the artwork's desired colour but does not alter the existing visual-approximation, Pantone-refinement, fabric, or ICC-profile calibration methods.
